metadata.title: Site image registry and admission check

components.title: Site image registry and admission check
components.description: The site registry (Zot, Harbor at HQ and large sites) and the Kyverno admission check of image signatures.

control-implementations.description: What the rendered registry and admission releases, the site install and the site's signed evidence export show.

implemented-requirements.description: The cluster admits only images signed with your organization's key.

statements.description: The site's admission policy site-images-signed denies, and fails closed on, any pod whose image signature does not verify with your organization's key. Its one exception is the Zot registry pod, matched by its exact pinned digest in its own namespace with no init or ephemeral container, and a Harbor site has no exception; the render refuses an exception without a digest, outside the site registry, with a pattern or in another namespace. The site install sets admission to Deny only after the image import found every signature. On the running site, the signed evidence export counts the enforcing image policies and the unsigned images they let through.
statements.remarks: Your organization signs the images it imports with its own key and produces the evidence export at least weekly.

implemented-requirements.description: The registry uses no public default credential.

statements.description: Harbor renders behind HTTPS on the HAProxy ingress with none of its chart's public default credentials; the import password for a Zot registry reaches htpasswd and the cluster on standard input only.
statements.remarks: Your organization's install writes the site's own registry credentials.

implemented-requirements.description: The registry's audit events reach the evidence export.

statements.description: On the running site, the signed evidence export counts the registry's audit events in the last day; the deployment collector passes only when there is at least one.
statements.remarks: Your organization reviews the registry's audit events.
